description: This file contains assembly implementations of cryptographic functions (gcm_gmult_ssse3 and gcm_ghash_ssse3) for BoringSSL, specifically optimized for the Raspberry Pi 4 64-bit architecture using SSSE3 instructions. It includes conditional compilation for different features and external symbol references.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_ssse3
methods.description: Assembly implementation of Galois field multiplication optimized with SSSE3 instructions.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_ssse3
methods.description: Assembly implementation of GHASH function using SSSE3 instructions.
